text:
Kathy takes the Miami condominium by right of survivorship. Bill's signed deed was delivered to her, so it was a completed present conveyance to the two of them as tenants by the entirety (they were married), and the prenup waived only rights arising from the marriage, not rights Bill gave her by deed. Tommy takes the Deerwoods pasture, and the remaining assets pass equally to Tommy and Julie, with Julie getting nothing specific because the devise of the condo to her fails. Kathy gets nothing more from the estate, because her pretermitted-spouse and elective-share rights were waived.

CONFIDENCE: 80
